summary: Q336 P1+P2 add the shared TaskManifest v1 approval contract and replicated immutable task-grant creation/revocation records; mutation routes remain dark until the P3 caller binding.

replay.detail: Task-grant creation and revocation claims rebuild grant state through the normal projector; expiry is derived from the manifest window.

schema.detail: Registers durable task-grant.created and task-grant.revoked claims and a task-grant subject family. TaskManifest v1 uses camelCase, rejects unknown fields, and binds approval to RFC 8785 canonical JSON SHA-256. Closed recursive locators mirror http-capture without ephemeral refs: UTF-16 text bounds, closed ARIA roles, at most 32 nodes/depth 8 and outermost-only withinFrame. CSS syntax is checked at dispatch, not grant creation. Delete effects are click-only; target requires delete; human kind/note and fillSecret inventoryId are operation-exclusive. Reader inventory IDs must be declared by writes or fillSecret steps; fillSecret IDs absent from writes are requester-only, allowing read-only login secrets without granting unrelated readers.

rules.detail: No admission or per-use enforcement in P1+P2; those remain P4/P5.

compatibility.detail: Adds POST /v1/task-grants, GET /v1/task-grants/{id}, POST /v1/task-grants/{id}/revoke and typed Rust client methods. Mutations default to 403 caller-binding-unavailable; no caller-supplied header grants authority.

manual.detail: P3 must supply the kernel-bound service/op-proxy authority before production mutations are enabled.

recovery.detail: Retain the durable claims when rolling back; grant records contain only identifiers, locators and non-secret literals, never secret values.
